scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 24 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.

title: Montserrat Mountain Roads
slogan: A 285 km loop out of Montserrat Mountain Roads
story: A proper escape from Barcelona with roads worth waking up for. A 206 km loop that starts and ends near Montmeló, about 3 h 45 of riding. It goes by way of Montserrat Mountain Roads, la Marina del Prat Vermell and El Prat de Llobregat. Premià de Mar is the high point. The line favours views over speed. The plan has 1 food stop and 1 fuel stop marked.
